metadata.title: feat: Add Vite watch mode to make dev for React app hot reload
metadata.author: vishu-bh

description:
## Summary

Implements Vite watch mode in `make dev` to enable automatic React app rebuilding during development, maintaining the same URL structure as production (http://localhost:8000/app).

## Changes

- **Makefile**: Updated `dev` target to run Vite in watch mode (`build --watch`)
- **client/vite.config.ts**: Removed dev server proxy config, enabled sourcemaps for debugging
- **Fixed**: cd client error by using subshells in Makefile
- **Updated**: `stop-dev` target to properly stop Vite watch process

## How It Works

1. Vite runs in watch mode, continuously rebuilding to `mcpgateway/static/app/`
2. Python backend serves the built files at http://localhost:8000/app
3. File changes trigger automatic rebuilds (manual browser refresh required)
4. Sourcemaps enabled for debugging in browser DevTools

## Testing

✅ Verified:
- Vite watch mode starts successfully
- Build completes in ~775ms
- React app accessible at http://localhost:8000/app (HTTP 200)
- Auto-rebuild on file changes works
- Graceful fallback to Python-only mode if npm not installed

## Usage

```bash
make dev              # Start both Vite watch + Python backend
make stop-dev         # Stop both processes
```

Access: http://localhost:8000/app (same as production)

## Related

Part of epic/ui-rewrite - React app development workflow improvements
